_comment: Data 4o (1b), 2026-11-13: Magic Mirror routes, one per Castora map, owner-measured (owner decision 2026-11-12 ~22:20 UTC: owner measurements live here in config/, like config/ls3_currencies.json). Each map has a full sweep and an efficient variant (medium / large chests only and the mirrors that open them) in one variant group, once a day per account (every chest and keepsake box once a day per account). Totals: full = medium chests x 2 + Long-Lost Keepsake Boxes (one per mirror finished) x 3 (owner 2026-11-12 11:34, research note section 10 in the addon repo); efficient = the estimate in the owner's efficient-routes.json (3 a keepsake box on the route's mirrors + the medium count x 2; large chests pay more, not counted). Minutes: the efficient variant takes the full route's time (owner 2026-11-12). Guaranteed currency only. Positions and images: config/mirror_route_geometry.json and assets/mirror-maps/ (tools/mirror_maps_import.py).

maps.description: Map requires you to gain 5 additional keys through events, do this before route start
